spec2def(telephon.cpl telephon.spec)
add_rc_deps(telephon.rc ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/resources/applet.ico)

# telephon.cpl is all Rust (telephon-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/telephon-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# telephon.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/telephon-rust/src/telephon/telephon.rs)
# The resources are the one thing cmake still compiles, in this OBJECT library
# whose windres command the cargo link replays.
add_library(telephon_res OBJECT telephon.rc)
target_compile_definitions(telephon_res PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
target_include_directories(telephon_res PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
set(TELEPHON_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/sdk/lib/uuid/libuuid.a)
add_cargo_module(telephon telephon-cargo telephon.cpl
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE telephon-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS telephon_res ${TELEPHON_REUSED})
